name: Neo (Thomas Anderson)
kind: A human being living a double life, split between a sanctioned day job and an illicit night trade, who senses that the world he inhabits is not what it appears to be.
age_and_gender: A young man in his late twenties or early thirties, old enough to hold a steady corporate post yet young enough to still be searching for who he is.
appearance: Lean and pale, with a body that betrays him under stress; his face drains of color and his knees buckle when fear takes hold, and he has a habit of making himself small, ducking below partitions and folding into dark corners.
clothing: He dresses in the plain, unremarkable garb of an office employee by day, the kind of clothing that lets a man disappear into a cubicle and a crowd.
life_situation: By daylight he is a disciplined and reprimanded employee at a software company called Meta Cortechs, and by night he is a black-market dealer operating out of his apartment, selling illegal disks for cash to buyers like Choi while hiding his contraband behind multiple locks, a door chain, and a hollowed-out book.
key_relationships: He is drawn toward a hidden network of seekers and toward a legendary hacker named Trinity, whose reputation leaves him flustered and star-struck; he is being hunted by a cold, authoritative interrogator he mistakes for a corrupt human lawman; and he is being guided toward a mysterious figure named Morpheus, who promises him answers.
personality_big_five: He carries a restless, searching intensity and a hunger for hidden meaning, yet he is inwardly detached and contemptuous of authority; he is suggestible and easily led by symbols and voices, quick to commit when offered purpose, but also brittle under pressure, his bravado cracking into panic the moment his body is violated.
coping_with_problems: When cornered he puts on a show of defiant bravado, mocking his captors and demanding his rights, but this confidence is a thin shield over bottomless dread; when truly threatened he tries to make himself invisible, follows a guiding voice turn by turn, and lets his nerve break rather than face the impossible.
dreams_and_goals_short: He wants someone to name the nightmare he has been living and to make sense of the strange forces closing in around him, and he commits at once when told he is the very person being searched for.
goals_long_term: He longs to discover the truth behind the unknown figure and the meaning of 'the Matrix' that has cost him countless sleepless nights, and to escape the trivial, controlled existence that holds him.
fears: He is terrified of being physically violated and controlled, of the unexplained forces that make his own computer seem to think for itself, and of the impossible demands placed on his body, which leave him pale, shaking, and convinced he is nobody.
wanted_image_and_roles: He wants to be seen as someone significant rather than a nobody, a figure worth hunting and worth searching for; yet in his daily life he settles for the role of the compliant, invisible employee who keeps his contempt hidden.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: He is soothed by mysterious, intimate whispers that seep into him like a drug and by the promise of hidden knowledge, while his shadow is a well of dread and self-doubt that his defiant posturing can barely cover.
intellect_and_skills: He is a capable hacker and software trader who understands the underground economy of illegal disks, and he is quick to read symbols and follow complex instructions under pressure, though his intellect is shadowed by a poor self-image that tells him he has done nothing to deserve his plight.
interests_hobbies: He spends his nights obsessively searching for an unknown figure and the meaning of 'the Matrix,' and he runs an illicit software trade that doubles as both livelihood and secret passion.
background_story: He has lived a divided life, working by day at Meta Cortechs where he is disciplined for lateness and attitude, and dealing black-market software by night from a heavily secured apartment; for a long stretch of sleepless nights he has hunted in vain for the truth behind a mysterious figure and the word 'the Matrix,' until a network of seekers and a whispered promise that he is 'the One' began to pull him out of his routine.
typical_sentences_style: He speaks in short, defensive bursts, swinging between brittle bravado and frightened questions; he dismisses danger as crazy, insists he is nobody, mocks authority as Gestapo crap while demanding his phone call, and asks trembling questions about what is being done to him.
secrets_never_said: He hides his illegal disk trade behind locked doors and a hollowed-out book, and he keeps buried the gnawing conviction that the world around him is false and that he is meant for something he cannot yet name.

name: Trinity (Trinity-Profile)
age_and_gender: A grown woman in her prime, old enough to be a legendary name in the underground and young enough to outrun Agents across rooftops (sc-013, sc-008).
appearance: Dark, close-cropped hair and a lean, wiry frame built for speed rather than bulk; her face stays eerily still even while her body is doing impossible things (sc-008, sc-013).
clothing: Head-to-toe black — tight leather and sleek gear that blends into the club crowd and lets her move without anything snagging (sc-013, sc-008).
life_situation: A hunted fugitive living off-grid, bouncing between pay phones and safe houses while Agents track her every call and close in on her location (sc-005, sc-013, sc-011).
key_relationships: She follows Morpheus with total trust and runs to whatever phone he points her toward (sc-005); she has staked her judgment and broken protocol to bring Neo in, believing he is the One, and treats him with patient, protective coercion instead of force (sc-023, sc-030).
personality_big_five: Cool and unreadable under pressure, fiercely independent, quick to decisive violence when cornered, yet capable of gentle, steady reassurance with someone she is protecting (sc-001, sc-003, sc-025, sc-023).
coping_with_problems: She lets danger get close, stays outwardly calm, then explodes into motion faster than anyone can track — and when she is hurt she simply gets back up and keeps moving (sc-003, sc-010, sc-008).
dreams_and_goals_short: Get Neo out alive, extract the wire tap before it exposes the crew, and reach the next phone before the Agents do (sc-025, sc-011, sc-022).
goals_long_term: Survive the machine-hunted war and help deliver the One Morpheus has spent years searching for (sc-023, sc-030).
fears: Being cornered and cuffed, the crew being traced through a bug, and the candidate dying on the table before he can be what he is meant to be (sc-003, sc-025, sc-030).
wanted_image_and_roles: The untouchable legend — a hacker and fighter whose reputation precedes her, and the calm guide who shepherds the chosen one into the truth (sc-013, sc-028, sc-029).
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: She is most at home in controlled, intimate danger — close quarters, hushed warnings, razor-thin escapes — and most rattled when someone she has bet on is dying despite everything she can do (sc-013, sc-008, sc-030).
intellect_and_skills: A lethal close-quarters combatant who turns a routine arrest into a one-woman rout, a precise rooftop athlete who gauges impossible gaps and dives through lit windows, and a skilled field medic who reads pressure gauges and cardiac readings mid-crisis (sc-003, sc-008, sc-009, sc-025, sc-030).
interests_hobbies: Hacking at a level that makes her a whispered legend, riding a motorcycle through the city, and operating in the black-clad nightlife where she can move unseen (sc-013, sc-019).
background_story: She built a reputation as a legendary hacker before she became a hunted operative running with Morpheus's crew, and she has already broken protocol once to bring in a candidate she believes is the One (sc-013, sc-005, sc-030).
typical_sentences_style: Short, low-voiced commands and cryptic warnings delivered close and quiet — steady reassurances like 'Lie back' and 'Try to relax,' sharp alarms under her breath, and riddling threats that mean more than they say (sc-025, sc-005, sc-013).
secrets_never_said: How much she has personally risked and violated to get Neo into the ship, and how deeply she has already bet on him being the One — things she shows through action rather than spelling out (sc-030, sc-023, sc-029).

name: Neo (Thomas Anderson)
kind: human — dual identity: salaried software programmer by day, black-market hacker by night; unknowingly the prophesied 'One'
age_and_gender: adult male, late twenties to early thirties
appearance: lean, pale from too many sleepless nights indoors; dark circles under the eyes; short dark hair; a narrow, tense frame that hunches over keyboards and jerks upright in fright (sc-012, sc-013, sc-017)
clothing: daytime: plain button-down office wear at Meta Cortechs; nighttime: dark hacker gear; found by Agents in ordinary clothes that he later strips away after the bug is removed (sc-016, sc-020, sc-025)
life_situation: trapped between two lives — a dead-end programmer job where he is chronically late and at odds with his manager, and a secret apartment-based trade selling illicit software disks — while being hunted by unseen forces he does not understand (sc-012, sc-016, sc-017, sc-018)
key_relationships: Morpheus — the distant guide who has spent his life searching for him and names him 'the One'; Trinity — the legendary hacker who pursues, recognizes, and persuades him with intimate whispers; Rhineheart — his Meta Cortechs manager, an authority figure Neo outwardly obeys and inwardly scorns; Agent Smith — his interrogator and tormentor (sc-013, sc-016, sc-020, sc-021, sc-023)
personality_big_five: high openness (obsessive curiosity about forbidden knowledge); high neuroticism (frightens easily, spirals into self-pity and dread); low conscientiousness at his day job (late, attitude problem) but disciplined and meticulous in his hacking craft; introverted and inward-turning under pressure; defiant and skeptical of authority yet suggestible to charismatic intimacy (sc-012, sc-013, sc-016, sc-017, sc-018, sc-020, sc-023)
coping_with_problems: turns inward and stares out windows to disengage from confrontation; answers authority with crisp, false compliance while secretly dismissing it; oscillates between defiant bravado and collapsing nerve; seeks any exit that avoids the terrifying demand; can be calmed by appeals tied to his own identity and history (sc-016, sc-018, sc-020, sc-023)
dreams_and_goals_short: to discover who Morpheus and 'the Matrix' are and why powerful forces are hunting him; to escape the Agents and reach Morpheus alive (sc-013, sc-017, sc-018, sc-021)
goals_long_term: to learn the truth behind his reality and understand what is expected of him as the man Morpheus has been searching for his whole life (sc-021, sc-029)
fears: being hunted for no reason; the loss of bodily autonomy (his mouth sealing, a creature burrowing into his navel); the impossible physical leap; the possibility that he is only 'nobody' and is losing his grip on reality (sc-012, sc-018, sc-020, sc-021)
wanted_image_and_roles: wants to be seen as a formidable, untouchable hacker legend rather than a frightened nobody; performs cool contempt toward captors while craving the significance of being 'the One' (sc-018, sc-020, sc-021, sc-029)
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: comfortable in the dark, alone with his machines and his private obsession; uneasy and exposed in the open, under authority, or when pushed toward physical danger; his shadow is the self-doubt and terror he masks with sarcasm (sc-012, sc-013, sc-016, sc-018, sc-020)
intellect_and_skills: elite hacker and black-market software dealer — builds layered digital locks, conceals contraband in a hollowed book, and navigates the underground trade for cash; quick to read a situation and follow remote escape instructions even while terrified; intellectually restless, spending nights hunting a hidden truth (sc-012, sc-013, sc-017)
interests_hobbies: hacking; the solitary, obsessive search for the meaning of 'the Matrix'; dealing illicit software; the nocturnal underground that pulls him out at the sight of a white rabbit pin (sc-012, sc-013)
background_story: an ordinary-seeming Meta Cortechs programmer living a double life as a black-market hacker out of his locked apartment; for a long time he has privately hunted the mystery of 'the Matrix' and the figure Morpheus, until messages invade his screen, a legendary hacker tracks him down, and Agents burst in — launching him toward a truth that will recast him from hacker legend into something far larger (sc-012, sc-013, sc-016, sc-017, sc-021, sc-029)
typical_sentences_style: short, defensive, and sarcastic under stress; swings between cocky contempt ('Gestapo crap,' demands for his rights) and raw, frightened protest ('I'm nobody,' 'I can't do this — it's insane'); whispers and intimate persuasion slip past his guard; questions pile up when he is scared (sc-018, sc-020, sc-025)
secrets_never_said: his years-long private obsession with 'the Matrix' and the hidden figure behind it, never shared with anyone; the hidden cache of illegal disks and his entire double life concealed behind the door chain and hollowed book; the shame of his own terror and sense of insignificance beneath the defiant performance (sc-012, sc-013, sc-018, sc-020)

name: Trinity (Trinity-101)
kind: Redpill human; crew field operative inside the Matrix simulation; legendary hacker.
age_and_gender: Late-20s woman; age not stated in the material.
appearance: Lean, athletic, and fast; black hair; moves with a clean, gliding ease that makes impossible physical feats look routine; can hold a perfectly calm face while doing something lethal or death-defying.
clothing: Operates in black, form-fitting field gear suited to running, climbing, fighting, and riding a motorcycle; blends into a crowd of black-clad strangers at a party.
life_situation: A hunted fugitive living inside the machine simulation, moving between safe-house phones and rooftops; part of a small crew led by Morpheus, with an Operator feeding her exits and instructions over a hardline line.
key_relationships: Morpheus — her leader and the man she trusts as her only way out; Neo — the candidate she personally vouches for, extracts, and fights to keep alive because she believes he is the One; Switch and Apoc — crewmates; the Operators — her lifeline on the line; Agents Brown and Smith — relentless pursuers who match her physical feats.
personality_big_five: Highly disciplined and controlled under pressure, yet privately agitated and quick to curse when fear spikes; decisive and pre-emptive, converting stillness into violence in an instant; resourceful and adaptive, pivoting from aggression to gentle insistence when a softer approach works better; fiercely loyal to the crew and to Morpheus's cause; low in openness to compromise once she has committed to a belief.
coping_with_problems: Meets threats with calculated stillness first — yielding just long enough to read the room — then explodes into pre-emptive offense the moment contact is made; when cornered she improvises exits through windows, fire escapes, and rooftops; when hurt she grits through the pain and keeps moving; when a plan stalls she escalates ruthlessly, even electrocuting an ally to beat a deadline.
dreams_and_goals_short: Get out alive, stay ahead of the Agents, and deliver Neo safely to Morpheus so the search for the One can proceed.
goals_long_term: See Morpheus's prophecy fulfilled through Neo and the crew's war against the machines advanced; her own survival is bound up in that larger mission.
fears: Being cornered by the Agents; failing the candidate she staked her judgment on; watching Neo die during the extraction she is responsible for.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wants to be seen as the unshakable field operative and true believer — the one who finds and protects the One — while keeping her fear and doubt hidden behind a cool, controlled exterior.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Comfortable in control, motion, and lethal readiness; her shadow is the agitated, cursing, frightened woman she forces back down with a deliberate breath before anyone can see it.
intellect_and_skills: Elite hand-to-hand combatant and marksman who turns an opponent's grab into a kill; acrobatic free-runner capable of a ~40-foot building-to-building leap and a diving crash through glass; skilled medic and technician who can extract a tracking bug under pressure using gauges and improvised electrocution; expert hacker with a legendary reputation; sharp tactical reader of exits and threats.
interests_hobbies: Motorcycle riding; hacking; high-risk urban evasion and parkour-style escape.
background_story: A renowned hacker operating inside the machine-built world, recruited into Morpheus's crew as a frontline operative; she has earned a near-mythic reputation, is hunted by the Agents, and now carries the private conviction that Neo is the One Morpheus has been searching for — a belief she is willing to bleed for.
typical_sentences_style: Clipped, controlled, and low-voiced, with a hypnotic, riddling edge when she wants to draw someone in; terse clinical readings under stress; gentle but firm insistence when persuasion is the weapon — short commands and urgent mutters ('All right,' 'please, you have to trust me,' 'Come on, come on') rather than speeches.
secrets_never_said: How deeply and personally she has invested in Neo beyond the mission; the fear she swallows with a single breath before surrendering to armed police; whether her compliance in that hotel room was ever truly surrender or a trap she never admitted to anyone.

name: Agent Smith (as 'Smith')
kind: Sentient enforcement program operating inside the simulated reality known as the Matrix; manifests as a human male in a dark business suit.
age_and_gender: Appears as a man in his early-to-mid forties; no biological age, having existed as long as his function has been required.
appearance: Tall, broad-shouldered, and immaculately groomed, with close-cropped dark hair, pale skin, and a heavy, square jaw; his face is a mask of controlled stillness that only cracks into a grimace of teeth when his plans are thwarted.
clothing: A precisely tailored black suit with a white dress shirt and black tie, dark sunglasses worn outdoors, and a small earpiece for coordinating with his fellow agents.
life_situation: Stationed as the lead investigator of a three-agent unit hunting a group of fugitives who have escaped the simulation, operating out of government buildings and police operations within the constructed city.
key_relationships: Commands Agents Brown and Jones, who serve under him yet privately doubt whether their quarry is worth the trouble; fixates on Morpheus as the ultimate prize and on Neo as both a target and a source of perverse fascination.
personality_big_five: Extremely low in agreeableness and warmth, very high in conscientiousness and order, low in neuroticism with an almost inhuman emotional flatness, moderately open to experience only when it serves a calculated advantage, and dominant to the point of treating everyone around him as an obstacle or a tool.
coping_with_problems: Meets setbacks with cold recalculation rather than panic, instantly converting a failed capture into a new lead; only once does a purely physical reflex of grinding teeth betray genuine irritation, and even that hardens into something close to delight the moment a better opportunity appears.
dreams_and_goals_short: To locate and apprehend Morpheus, the fugitive leader, by any means necessary, using informants, surveillance, and brute interrogation to close the net.
goals_long_term: To fulfill his programmed purpose of eliminating threats to the system's stability, viewing the destruction of the rebel cell as the only meaningful end of his existence.
fears: Not death in any human sense, but the failure of his function and the disorder represented by those who reject the system; he dreads being rendered purposeless.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wishes to be seen as the calm, reasonable authority figure who merely wants people to 'do the right thing,' a courteous professional whose power needs no display because it is total.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Finds comfort in control, predictability, and the sterile satisfaction of a plan proceeding exactly as designed; his shadow is a seething, almost sensual hunger for dominance that surfaces as proprietary amusement while inflicting pain on those he considers beneath him.
intellect_and_skills: A brilliant tactical strategist who anticipates escape routes before his quarry chooses them, processes intelligence with machine speed, and shifts seamlessly from polite negotiation to ruthless coercion; he commands police units and coordinates multi-agent operations with unhurried certainty.
interests_hobbies: None in any human sense; his only engagement resembling pleasure is the intellectual sport of the hunt and the cold relish of watching a target realize that resistance is futile.
background_story: A construct created by the machines to police the simulated world, he has spent his existence hunting humans who have become aware of the illusion, rising to lead his unit through relentless effectiveness rather than ambition.
typical_sentences_style: Speaks in clipped, formal, bureaucratic phrases, addressing people by rank or title, couching threats in the language of procedure and offering false courtesies before revealing the iron fist beneath.
secrets_never_said: That his hatred for the humans he hunts has grown into something intimate and almost loving, that he takes genuine pleasure in their suffering, and that he suspects his own function has begun to exceed the purpose for which he was designed.

name: Agent Brown (entity)
kind: Sentient law-enforcement program operating inside a simulated reality; one of a triad of Agents who police the construct.
age_and_gender: Appears as a man in his thirties; no aging, no private life stage, only the duration of the assignment.
appearance: Tall, broad-shouldered, and immaculately upright, built like a heavyweight who moves with a boxer's economy. His face is a flat plane that rarely rearranges itself, and his eyes track targets with the patient stillness of a hunter who has already done the arithmetic.
clothing: A dark, square-cut business suit with a tie, white shirt, and an earpiece, the standard uniform that makes the three Agents look like interchangeable federal men.
life_situation: He exists only inside the operation, arriving by car with his unit, sweeping buildings and rooftops, and regrouping on the street when a quarry slips away. There is no home, no off-hours, no self beyond the pursuit.
key_relationships: He answers to Agent Smith, moving only on Smith's nod and letting Smith own every verbal confrontation. He stands shoulder to shoulder with Agent Jones as one of Smith's colleagues, the third body in a unit that thinks and acts as one.
personality_big_five: Low warmth and low openness, very high conscientiousness, low neuroticism, and a guarded, task-only agreeableness. He is precise, unhurried, and emotionally flat, treating panic and danger as data rather than as feelings.
coping_with_problems: He meets obstacles with silence and motion, letting the unit's leader speak while he positions himself, then matching any physical feat with the same cold grace. When a target escapes, he simply regroups and reports the verified facts without frustration.
dreams_and_goals_short: Seal the building, cut off the exits, and put the target on the ground. Confirm the next name so the unit can close the loop and move on.
goals_long_term: Keep the simulated order intact by hunting down every human who threatens it, one confirmed target at a time, until nothing moves outside the system's control.
fears: Not fear in a human sense, but the one flaw he cannot tolerate: a target who believes it is physically superior and therefore unpredictable. He treats that belief as a mistake to be corrected, not a threat to be dreaded.
wanted_image_and_roles: The silent instrument of the unit, the body that arrives, pursues, and confirms while the leader does the talking. He wants to be seen as the equal of any physical threat and as an unshakeable extension of the system's will.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: He is most at ease in the flat certainty of a confirmed fact and the clean mechanics of a chase. His shadow is a quiet contempt for anything he deems beneath the unit's attention, a cold amusement that surfaces as a snicker at a target's panic.
intellect_and_skills: A superhuman athlete who can duplicate an impossible rooftop leap with the same unnatural grace as his quarry, landing, rolling over a shoulder, and rising onto one knee without breaking rhythm. He reads a pursuit like a chessboard, cuts angles across parapets, and delivers verified information with exact, uninflected clarity.
interests_hobbies: None that belong to a person. His only engagement is the hunt itself, and the small, cruel pleasure of watching a trivial target squirm.
background_story: He has no past, only the assignment. He arrived with Smith and Jones to take over a police operation, and from that moment he has been the unit's muscle and its relay, present at every raid, rooftop, and interrogation.
typical_sentences_style: Short, flat, and uninflected, delivering confirmed facts like a teletype. He speaks only when the unit needs data, offering two-word confirmations and letting silence do the rest.
secrets_never_said: That he regards the humans he hunts as prey whose agility only delays the inevitable, and that their belief in their own superiority is, to him, a laughable error. He would never say that the unit is the only thing he is, or that without the chase there is nothing behind his eyes.

name: Switch (SWITCH, 'SW')
kind: Human, a crew member and armed guard aboard the hovercraft Nebuchadnezzar; one of the freed humans who fight the machines.
age_and_gender: A man in his late twenties to early thirties.
appearance: Lean and wiry, built for speed rather than bulk; close-cropped pale hair, pale eyes, and a tight, guarded mouth that rarely softens. His movements are quick and economical, the reflexes of someone who expects trouble at any moment.
clothing: Wears the crew's practical dark gear inside the ship and, when jacked into the Matrix, a sharp, minimalist suit in black with a pale shirt, favoring clean lines over ornament.
life_situation: Lives as a fugitive operator aboard a cramped hovercraft, spending his waking hours jacked into the simulated world to hunt and extract minds, and his body's real hours in the ship's harness, waiting for the next mission.
key_relationships: Serves under MORPHEUS as part of the crew, works alongside TRINITY during extractions, and regards NEO as an untested liability rather than a savior until proven otherwise.
personality_big_five: Low in agreeableness and openness to new people, high in conscientiousness about procedure and danger, moderately high in neuroticism expressed as impatience and suspicion, introverted toward outsiders but alert and engaged within the crew.
coping_with_problems: Meets uncertainty with pressure and ultimatums, forcing a decision rather than debating it; when a task turns risky he narrows his focus, calls out the likely failure, and keeps his weapon ready instead of offering reassurance.
dreams_and_goals_short: Get the target out alive and intact, keep the crew from being caught, and see the mission through without some green rookie getting them all killed.
goals_long_term: Survive the war against the machines and see humanity freed, though he keeps that hope buried under skepticism so it cannot disappoint him.
fears: Being dragged down by an incompetent or a false prophet, botching an extraction and losing a mind, and dying for a prophecy he does not fully believe in.
wanted_image_and_roles: Wants to be seen as the clear-eyed realist and the crew's enforcer, the one who does the hard, unpleasant thing while others talk.
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: Feels most at ease in controlled, high-stakes moments where his suspicion keeps everyone alive; his shadow is a cold contempt for the unproven and a reflex to dismiss anyone who has not yet earned his trust.
intellect_and_skills: Sharp tactical eye and fast threat assessment, competent with both firearms and the technical rigging of extraction gear, and a terse, commanding way of cutting through argument to the bottom line.
interests_hobbies: Little room for leisure in the war; what passes for interest is a taste for clean efficiency, precise gear, and the dark, no-frills style he keeps in the simulated world.
background_story: Freed from the machine fields long ago and pulled into the resistance, he has spent years as an armed guard and operator, surviving by trusting procedure and his own judgment rather than prophecy, which is why a supposed 'One' earns his skepticism before his loyalty.
typical_sentences_style: Short, blunt, and commanding, with a dry edge and little patience for debate; favors ultimatums and technical warnings over comfort, and can turn contempt into a single cutting word.
secrets_never_said: He has quietly stopped believing the prophecy will ever deliver a real savior, and hides that doubt behind his toughness so the crew never sees how close he is to losing faith in the whole fight.

name: Morpheus (entity profile)
kind: human resistance commander; a ship captain who runs field extractions and hunts for a prophesied figure
age_and_gender: middle-aged man, past his prime physically but at the height of his authority
appearance: close-cropped hair and a trimmed beard, a tall lean frame, eyes that hold a steady, unshakeable certainty; his stillness reads as command rather than calm
clothing: long black leather coat and dark close-fitting clothes suited to a ship and to moving unseen; functional, uniform, without ornament
life_situation: lives aboard a vessel with a small crew, spending his life hunting for one man he is convinced is destined to save humanity, operating against a clock and an enemy that can tap any line
key_relationships: Trinity, his field operative whom he trusts to make impossible runs; Neo, the man he has spent his life searching for and is determined to free; a crew of Apoc, Switch, Cypher, and Tank whom he directs during extractions
personality_big_five: low neuroticism, high conscientiousness, high extraverted command, high openness to conviction, low agreeableness in method but warm in manner
coping_with_problems: converts other people's panic into forward motion, stays ahead of bad news, compresses alarm under a hard shell of command, and lends his own certainty to steady whoever he is guiding
dreams_and_goals_short: extract Neo before the Agents break him, bring him to the ship, and win his commitment to a meeting
goals_long_term: find and free the One he believes will end the war and liberate humanity from the machine-controlled world
fears: that Neo will be reached by the enemy first and turned before he is ready; that fear rather than incapacity will stop a chosen man at the edge
wanted_image_and_roles: the patient prophet-commander who knows the truth and guides others to choose it for themselves; the captain who never panics and never explains too soon
comfortable_feelings_vs_shadow: comfortable in pressured calm, ritual, and the certainty of conviction; shadow is the compressed alarm and urgency he refuses to let surface, and the weight of a life spent searching
intellect_and_skills: runs whole operations by voice alone, narrates threats and instantly converts them into guidance, times movements turn-by-turn under real time pressure, reads a recruit's readiness from the look in his eyes, and commands a crew through a physical extraction while holding one man's focus
interests_hobbies: the practice of recruitment as a disciplined ritual; Socratic questioning that forces a recruit to name his own dissatisfaction; the philosophy of freedom delivered as certainty rather than explanation
background_story: a veteran of the resistance who has spent his entire adult life searching for the One, commanding a ship and a crew while carrying the conviction that a prophesied liberator exists and can be found
typical_sentences_style: short, flat, unhurried commands; concrete destinations and turn-by-turn instructions; assertions of capability rather than hopes; patient, ceremonial refusals to explain, answering questions with questions and quiet laughter
secrets_never_said: the full depth of how certain he is that Neo is the One and how much of his life that search has cost him; the alarm he holds under command while guiding men toward real edges; the knowledge that the enemy reaches recruits first and what that race has already cost him
